briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Sun-Scale Verdict Descent pressure at The Sun-Scale Gate. First Light Under Dead Stone. Aten Ra advances through sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure. The field should read as Solar Dominion of Khepra source culture, not generic fantasy scenery.

missionIntro.speaker: Aten Ra Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The path asks for order. One Deity enters; even a divine giant must not mistake brightness for safety.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge as a test of Awakening: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Aten Ra Divine Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Aten Ra Divine Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

missionIntro.speaker: Empyrean Divine Voice

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Empyrean Choir Vault: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Empyrean Divine Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Empyrean Divine Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

missionIntro.speaker: Infernal Dominion Divine Voice

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Cinders of Dominion: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Infernal Dominion Divine Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Infernal Dominion Divine Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
